query:
The group settled on the birthday event plan. What did one member's response in that moment reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Anita
B. Kofi
C. Yvonne
D. James
context:
[1] (about=Anita, episodic, t4 @2025-01-29T19:09:00) Confirmed. The Year 5 meeting is the 15th. I will not be at the birthday event.
[2] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t4 @2025-01-29T19:13:00) I can be there if it is before noon. I appreciate being included. Y
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Anita, group-interaction, t14 @2025-03-05T19:02:00) Spring Fair date confirmed as 29th March; hall and main playground available.

[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Sharon, group-interaction, t4 @2025-01-29T19:06:00) Park birthday confirmed for Feb 15th, 11am, main bandstand area; booking confirmed.
[10] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t10 @2025-02-19T19:16:00) I have signed up. Looking forward to it. Speaking as someone who has not been to a group event in over a year - this is well overdue. Y
agent_answer:
A. Anita.

In that moment, Anita revealed her actual position: she would not be at the birthday event. The telling detail is her explicit wording: **“I will not be at the birthday event.”**
